_about: Skyscrapers layer, 150 m and taller (Toronto's cut-off), from Wikipedia's list. engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches it; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/melbourne/data/skyscrapers.geojson. Table names are checked against the fetch log (cities/melbourne/raw/skyscrapers/fetch.log). The list covers Greater Melbourne, mostly the CBD, Southbank and Docklands.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in Melbourne

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out.
